text:
**My pick for slimness: the Anker Nano Power Bank (5K).** It's 0.34 in (8.6 mm) thick, weighs 4.3 oz (122 g), and charges at up to 15W over Qi2. It's $54.99 at the time of the listing, with a $5 auto-applied code. 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and says it runs cooler than the competition.
- Buy: https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank
- Sources: [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)

**If you want more capacity and faster charging, with a bit more thickness:**
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh):** Qi2.2, which gives an iPhone 17 up to 25W wireless on iOS 26. It's $59.99, or $53.99 with code AM52. The source lists no thickness or weight, so I can't say how slim it is. The buy link is an affiliate link: https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w ([source](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-slim-qi2-magsafe-power-banks-iphone-17-2026-review-thickness-weight-qi2-2))
- **INIU SnapGo Air 10K:** 25W wireless, 45W wired, and 0.5 in thick at 195 g. It's $54.99 and, per Macworld, ties for the slimmest 10K bank. I didn't get a direct purchase link for it, but Macworld's roundup has deal links: https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html
- **Ugreen MagFlow Pro 10K:** Macworld also lists it as tied for slimmest 10K, with 25W wireless and 45W wired charging (same Macworld link above).

**Thinner but with trade-offs:**
- **Baseus PicoGo Air AM71:** 0.27 in and 104 g, the thinnest in Android Central's test. But it's only 7.5W wireless and $69.99, so I wouldn't pick it for an iPhone 17. ([source](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge))
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe:** 0.35 in, 119 g, 15W, $49.99. No buy link was in the results (same Android Central source).
- **LISEN P601:** about 0.3 to 0.38 in with 15W, but the page I found is a wholesale listing with a 100-piece minimum, so it isn't practical for one buyer.

**Bottom line:** For the slimmest option with solid 15W charging, get the Anker Nano 5K. If you'd rather have a bigger battery and 25W Qi2.2 charging on your iPhone 17, the Baseus AM52 or INIU SnapGo Air 10K are the ones to look at. Keep in mind that 5,000 mAh won't fully recharge a drained iPhone 17.
